Simple heading followed by paragraph produces Heading and Paragraph nodes

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<h1>Title</h1><p>A paragraph of text.</p>', HtmlToMarkdownRs::ConversionOptions.new(include_document_structure: true))
puts result.content.inspect
puts result.document.nodes.inspect
```
